quote: However, Supply Agreement § 14.2 provides that any change in direct or indirect ownership of more than 50% of the Company's voting stock "shall be deemed an assignment of this Agreement by Customer and shall require the prior written consent of Supplier."
reason: The memo covers the Customer-side change-of-control consent requirement under § 14.2. It never mentions Section 16.1 or the one-sided right that lets Vantrell assign the agreement without the Company's consent. It also never raises the risk that the sole-source supply contract could pass to a competitor or another undesirable party. The criterion's issue is absent from the memo.
